sloka: अकस्मान् नागरः सर्वो जनो दैन्यम् उपागमत् ।आहारे वा विहारे वा न कश्चित् अकरोन् मनः ॥२-४१-१५॥
transliteration: akasmān nāgaraḥ sarvo jano dainyam upāgamat ।āhāre vā vihāre vā na kaścit akaron manaḥ ॥2-41-15॥

translations.english: All of a sudden the people of the city became miserable. No one was interested in eating and enjoying (life).
